name: Saunders Park
description: Refurbished playground set among trees for shelter, with a playing surface designed by local artist Lois O'Hara. A paddling pool next to it opens in the summer (run by Freedom Leisure). Laz' in the Park café has public toilets, including a disabled toilet, open when the café is.
